notes.title: Ver1.121 update
notes.notes: Adjusted the effects when taking damage.

notes.title: Ver1.12 update
notes.notes:
The opening movie has been added.
You can watch it from the menu by clicking "Movie".

Time now stops for a moment when you take damage.

Effects have been adjusted.
Added effects to both player and enemy.

VS100 Robots
The effects of various items have been enhanced.
Some of the enemy variations have been changed.

notes.title: Ver1.1101 update
notes.notes: Review of minor bugs related to achievement ranking. Don't worry, there is no change in the appearance and ranking!

notes.title: Ver1.11 update
notes.notes:
List of effect enhancements
Circular effect when bumped.
Screen vibration doubled.
Added an effect when picking up an XS size object.
Effect will now appear when picking up XS sized objects ・Effect will now appear when reflecting or scattering objects
Throwing trajectory display by size is now very thick.
SM size items are now a little brighter.
When a player is ready to pick up a size L, it will glow the color of the player who can pick it up.
Players now blink.

notes.title: Ver1.013 update
notes.notes: The main menu has been made smoother to use.

notes.title: Ver1.011 update
notes.notes: Fixed behavior of Waste basket robot and Poly bucket robot.

notes.title: Ver1.01 update
notes.notes:
"Whole.
Adjusted the Allay Stage.

"VS100 Robo

notes.title: Ver1.0 update
notes.notes:
Whole.
New mode "VS100 Robot" implemented.
Added new stages and new achievements to go along with it

Adjusted Log in the Picnic stage.

VS PLAYER.
Selecting a random stage and choosing "Redo" will now randomly select the stage again

VS VIRUS
Fixed a bug that prevented vertical enemies from returning to the screen when they went off-screen.

Other minor fixes

Please note that the update will reset your save data. Please be aware of this.
